question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Consensus Q3 2026 EPS is ~$1.96-2.03 and operating-income guidance is $22.5-26.5B. Amazon routinely beats the top of its guide (Q2 OI was $27.5B), so ex-gain EPS is ~$2.10-2.20 assuming OI of $27-29B and a ~19% tax rate (my assumption) on ~10.95B diluted shares. Anthropic gains (Q1 $16.8B pre-tax, Q2 $50.5B) need an observable price change. I found no priced Anthropic round or tender in Jul-Sep 2026: the May Series H at $965B was the last, and the ~$2T IPO is targeted for November (Q4). So the base case has no large gain. I keep ~10% above $2.995 for an unreported Q3 observable transaction (e.g. the reported ~$15B September raise if it was priced equity) and ~2% below range for marketable-equity/warrant losses or a one-off charge. Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker market found.

- Q3 2026 guidance (Amazon Q2 release, Jul 30 2026): net sales $197-202B, operating income $22.5-26.5B (vs $17.4B in Q3 2025).
- Q2 2026 actual: OI $27.5B, net income $62.6B, diluted EPS $5.75; other income $53.4B, of which $50.486B is Anthropic upward adjustments, $1.449B warrant gains, $1.319B marketable equity gains, $0.227B FX (10-Q, Jun 30 2026). Diluted shares 10,903M.
- Q1 2026: diluted EPS $2.78, net income $30.3B, incl. $16.8B pre-tax Anthropic gains. Q3 2025: EPS $1.95 incl. $9.5B pre-tax Anthropic gain; Q2 2025 EPS $1.68.
- Accounting (10-Q): Anthropic nonvoting preferred stock (~$92.5B carrying) is under the measurement alternative, so P&L gains require an observable price change (funding round). Convertible notes (~$97.9B) are AFS with fair-value changes in OCI, not EPS.
- Anthropic financing timeline: Feb 2026 Series G $30B at $380B; April 2026 employee tender at $350B; May 28 2026 Series H $65B at $965B (Amazon invested $5B in each). Draft S-1 June 1 2026. Reports (Reuters Sept 11, WSJ Sept) say the IPO targets ~$2T and a Nasdaq listing in Oct/Nov 2026 (roadshow October). One aggregator mentions 'early Sept 2026 ~$15B raise' with banks; another source says the $15B was earlier hyperscaler commitments. I could not confirm any priced Q3 (Jul-Sep) equity transaction.
- Sell-side consensus Q3 2026 EPS ~ $1.96 (27 analysts) to $2.03 (Nasdaq); this generally excludes investment marks.
- Amazon historical pattern: OI usually at or above the top of guidance; EPS usually beats consensus.
- Downside non-operating risks: Rivian/marketable equity and warrant mark-to-market losses (±$1-2B per quarter typical), legal/one-off charges (Q3 2025 had a $2.5B FTC settlement and $1.8B severance).
- Searched for but not found: any Anthropic priced round/tender in Jul-Sep 2026; an Amazon pre-announcement; any prediction market on this EPS.

calls.reasoning: Resolves off Amazon Q3 2026 diluted GAAP EPS, expected ~Oct 28-29. Consensus is ~$1.96-2.03. Operating income was guided to $22.5-26.5B and Amazon has recently beaten the top of the range. With operating income of ~$27-28B, ~±$1B other income, a ~19-20% tax rate and ~10.95B shares, the median is ~$2.10. Large Anthropic gains need an observable priced transaction. None was found for Jul-Sep: Series H was in May, the IPO moved to November (Q4), and the September raise looks like debt. So the upside escape is ~8%. A large loss or charge pushing EPS below $0.995 is ~1.5%. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: consensus ~$1.96-2.03, Q3 operating-income guide $22.5-26.5B, Q2 operating income $27.5B, Anthropic preferred gains recognized only on observable price changes, convertible notes marked through OCI, and no priced Anthropic equity transaction found for Q3, with the IPO in Q4. Their medians differ ($2.03-2.15) only on judgment about the size of the operating beat, other income and the tax rate. Run 3's $2.03 assumes essentially no beat, which doesn't fit Amazon's beat history. Run 1's $2.15 needs a strong beat plus positive other income. I take ~$2.10. The open factual question, whether some undisclosed priced Anthropic transaction happened in Q3, cannot be settled without web access. I price it as an ~8% upper escape, consistent with all three runs' 8-10%. I carry forward their ~0.5-0.6 dispersion, which I agree with.
